content.short: Kii builds KiiChain, an on-chain FX and stablecoin layer for emerging-market finance.
content.description: Kii builds infrastructure for emerging economies, centred on KiiChain, an on-chain FX layer for stablecoins and real-world assets that helps businesses and people in emerging markets transact globally. Stable's official ecosystem page lists Kii Global.
content.meta: Kii builds KiiChain, an on-chain FX layer for stablecoins in emerging markets, listed on Stable.
